{{Quote|We're under attack by the Separatist garrison. Looks to be a full invasion.|Thorn|<ref name="CH" />}}
The '''invasion of Scipio''', otherwise known as the '''Battle of Scipio''' or the '''Banking Clan crisis''', was a conflict that took place on the [[planet]] [[Scipio]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. Having helped uncover corruption in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]], [[Rush Clovis]] was appointed as the new head of the bank, only to be coerced by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] into raising interest rates for the Republic, at which point Separatist forces occupied Scipio to cement their position. The Republic responded with its own invasion, allowing [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] to strengthen the Republic economically.

==Prelude==
Following the appointment of [[Senator]] [[Rush Clovis]] as head of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan|Banking Clan]],<ref name="TRoC" /> the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic]] met on Scipio to preside over Clovis's installation as the the new head of the Banking Clan. The Republic representative, Senator of [[Naboo]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] was accompanied by [[Clone Commander]] [[Thorn]] and a [[garrison]] of the [[Coruscant Guard]]'s [[diplomatic service]] whilst the Confederate representative, [[Separatist Congress Leader]] [[Bec Lawise]], was accompanied by several [[BX-series droid commando|commando droids]].<ref name="CH" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|You may begin your attack. It is time to make Rush Clovis look like a powerful Separatist.|Dooku, to [[Kraken]]|<ref name="CH" />}}
[[File:KeepFighting-SoR.png|thumb|300px|left|Commander Thorn makes his last stand surrounded by enemy battle droids.]]
Clovis was then blackmailed by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to raise the interest rates on the Republic and not the Separatists. This allowed the Confederacy to take full control of the Banks. Commander Thorn and his garrison then came under attack by [[Confederacy military|Confederate forces]]. Thorn informed Amidala of this as [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|''Hyena''-class Droid Fighter/Bombers]] destroyed his ships, including a dozen [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Republic gunships]] and a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class Armed Cruiser]].<ref name="CH" /> Storming Scipio,<ref name="Super Battle Droid 16">{{Databank|super-battle-droid-biography-gallery|Super Battle Droid Biography Gallery}} {{C|Slide 16}}</ref> Separatist [[HMP droid gunship]]s were deployed and unleashed [[B2-series super battle droid]]s and more commando droids, who surrounded and [[Death|killed]] Thorn and his men. Amidala informed [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] and the [[Jedi]]. Dooku then arrived and had Amidala taken hostage.<ref name="CH" />

Amidala was brought before Dooku, and when she refused to join him, Dooku ordered her to be arrested. Amidala then grabbed a [[blaster]] and Lawise refused to arrest her, knowing the [[Separatist Senate]] would not authorize her arrest. Dooku then forced Amidala to shoot Lawise.<ref name="CH" />

The [[Galactic Senate]] then voted to launch a counter-invasion. Dooku then left the planet and returned to the blockade when the [[Republic Navy|Republic fleet]] under [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] arrived. There, the Confederate forces in [[Realspace|space]] abandoned their units on the planet and jumped to [[hyperspace]]. The [[501st Legion]] then went [[planet]]-side to fight the [[Separatist Droid Army|Confederate ground forces]]. After finishing off the last of the Confederate forces, Scipio was secured. General Skywalker then stormed into [[Clovis' office]] to rescue Amidala. A blast then hit the office and Clovis and Amidala were then thrown off the side of the ledge. Skywalker grabbed both Amidala and Clovis. However, Skywalker was unable to hold onto both of them leading Clovis to let go of Skywalker, falling to his death. Skywalker was able to pull Amidala up.<ref name="CH" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|In hope of a better tomorrow, we cede control of the banks to the Office of the Chancellor of the Galactic Republic.|Nix Card|<ref name="CH" />}}
Following the battle, Senator [[Nix Card]] informed the Galactic Senate that the [[Muun]]s had chosen to cede control of the banks to the [[Office of the Chancellor]]. As a result, Palpatine secured a massive boost in power for his office,<ref name="CH" /> helping cement his station into that which would become that of [[Galactic Emperor]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and further gained the financial means to build<ref name="Trivia Gallery Image 5">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/crisis-at-the-heart-trivia-gallery|text="Crisis at the Heart" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Image 5 caption}}</ref> his planned [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ROTS" />
